blob.title: Blob Storage Integration
blob.description: Configure scheduled exports of your trace data to AWS S3, S3-compatible storages, or Azure Blob Storage. Set up a hourly, daily, or weekly export to your own storage for data analysis or backup purposes. Use the "Validate" button to test your configuration by uploading a small test file, and the "Run Now" button to trigger an immediate export.

blob.scoresHint: Scores are always exported in full.

integrations.posthogDescription: We have teamed up with <link>PostHog</link> (OSS product analytics) to make Langfuse events/metrics available in your PostHog dashboards. Upon activation, all historical data from your project will be synced. After the initial sync, new data is automatically synced every hour to keep your PostHog dashboards up to date.
integrations.mixpanelDescription: Integrate with <link>Mixpanel</link> to sync your Langfuse traces, generations, and scores for advanced product analytics. Upon activation, all historical data from your project will be synced. After the initial sync, new data is automatically synced every hour to keep your Mixpanel dashboards up to date.
Export traces, observations and scores. This is the legacy behavior prior to tracking traces and observations in separate tables. It is recommended to use the enriched observations option instead.
integrations.source.TRACES_OBSERVATIONS_: Traces and observations (legacy) and enriched observations

Export traces, observations, scores and enriched observations. This exports both the legacy data source (traces, observations) and the new one (enriched observations) and essentially exports duplicate data. Therefore, it should only be used to migrate existing integrations to the new recommended enriched observations and check validity of the data for downstream consumers of the export data.
integrations.source.EVENTS.label: Enriched observations (recommended)
integrations.source.EVENTS.description: Export enriched observations and scores. This is the recommended data source for integrations and will be the default for new integrations.

integrations.blocked.cloud-cutoff: This integration is configured to export legacy traces and observations, which is no longer available for this project. Saving is blocked until you select an available export source above.
integrations.blocked.legacy-writes-disab: This integration is configured to export legacy traces and observations, but this deployment runs LANGFUSE_MIGRATION_V4_WRITE_MODE=events_only and no longer writes the legacy traces/observations tables. Saving is blocked until you select an available export source above.
